recognize_zh: 大型組織球的細胞質豐富且帶空泡，內含被吞噬的嗜中性球、帶橘黃色的紅血球及核碎片，細胞質明確包圍這些細胞；在淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的背景下代表巨噬細胞活化與噬血現象。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and round nuclei with fine chromatin
Engulfed segmented neutrophil and band within the cytoplasm
Ingested red cells and orange-brown red cell remnants within phagocytic vacuoles
Nuclear debris and a pyknotic cell fragment within cytoplasm
Adjacent smudged cells; background red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large activated histiocytes with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm. The histiocytes contain engulfed neutrophils, erythrocytes and red cell remnants, and nuclear debris within clear phagocytic vacuoles. Adjacent smudged cells are present, and the background shows scattered red cells and platelets. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in this patient with EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the marrow, correlation with HLH diagnostic criteria is recommended.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris only, without intact ingested erythrocytes or neutrophils.
Overlying cells lie in a different focal plane without a surrounding phagocytic vacuole.

ddx.dx: Tumor cells with emperipolesis or cannibalism
ddx.vs: Tumor cells engulfing other cells have malignant nuclear features, whereas these phagocytes have bland histiocytic nuclei.
